goals: Provide a separate Fabric compatibility layer for exact Enderscape 3.0.2 on Minecraft Java 26.2 without modifying or repackaging the upstream jar.
Suppress future acquisition and discovery of owner-selected equipment while retaining registry identities needed by existing worlds and inventories.
Reconcile the audited Enderscape food-loot paths with exact current Matcha Flavoured component-bearing identities without changing Enderscape's original loot odds or counts.
Replace the selected native Enderscape foods' vanilla hunger restoration with the owner-selected current Matcha healing semantics while retaining their upstream effects and special behavior.
Remove Rubble Chitin from future normal acquisition and discovery while retaining its registry identity and changing only the Rubblemite reward identity to Nebulite Shards.
Replace the Void Campfire recipe with exact current Matcha Flavoured Kindling plus Void Shale, and move Veiled Sapling acquisition from passive leaf drops to a one-to-one Veiled Leaves recipe.
scope: Generate an always-enabled companion data overlay from the SHA-256-pinned Enderscape input, preserving audited loot-pool math while replacing only selected entries and current Matcha food identity components.

Filter only the owner-selected recipes, advancement branches, ordinary Creative/JEI discovery identities, normal enchantment availability, and exact Enderscape-specific direct hunger behavior through Fabric APIs and narrow 3.0.2 mixins.
Package, statically verify, retain, and document Canary 1 without launching Minecraft or changing any testing profile.

Generate C2 overrides for the exact Rubblemite and Veiled Leaves loot tables, the Void Campfire recipe, and the Veiled Sapling recipe; use one narrow custom crafting serializer only because current Matcha Kindling is a component-bearing vanilla item rather than a separate registry entry.

exclusions: Enderscape source or binary modification, registry deletion, fork, repackaging, or redistribution; the exact upstream jar remains installed separately and untouched.
Minecraft launches, runtime observations, Test Slot or Test Instance Manager changes, and any access to protected or retired gameplay profiles.
Changes to originals, WORKBENCH_SERVER_STATE.json, Matcha Flavoured, Matcha x JEI Integration, Enderscape's upstream repository, or any unrelated Workbench project.
End biome, terrain, world generation, structures other than the selected future loot evaluation, Magnia behavior/worldgen, Magnia Radio availability, and the potion/Void/brewing/arrow systems.
Claims that build, static checks, or generated artifacts prove Minecraft runtime safety.

It makes Rubble Chitin undiscoverable and unobtainable in future normal gameplay while preserving legacy registry/tag resolution and changing only Rubblemite's reward identity to Nebulite Shards; requires exact accepted Matcha Kindling plus Void Shale for the replacement Void Campfire recipe; and moves Veiled Sapling acquisition to the deliberate one-to-one Veiled Leaves recipe while preserving direct shears/Silk Touch leaf acquisition.
